versions.changelog:
- Added homepage and source fields for improved skill discoverability.
- Updated environment requirements to include both AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
- Added pip install instructions for dependencies under metadata.
- No code or functionality changes; documentation and metadata enhancements only.

- Removed test files: `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/test_aws_checks.py`.
- Updated `SKILL.md` with improved security model, dependency pinning, and clarified prerequisites.
- Expanded skill description to specify "15 read-only checks across 14 AWS services."
- Adjusted metadata to mark the skill as an executable and pinned `boto3` dependency.
- No functional changes to core evidence collection; this update focuses on documentation and test cleanup.

Initial release of auditclaw-aws, providing AWS compliance evidence collection for auditclaw-grc.

- Collects compliance evidence from AWS across 15 security/compliance check categories.
- Stores all evidence in the auditclaw-grc shared compliance database.
- Includes commands for full evidence sweep and targeted checks (S3, IAM, CloudTrail, VPC, and more).
- Requires minimal, custom IAM read-only policy (do not use broader AWS managed policies).
- Provides detailed setup instructions for creating and configuring the auditclaw-scanner user and policy.
- Automatic boto3 installation on first use; supports both AWS CLI configuration and environment variables for credentials.
